name: LaunchOutlook
label: Launch Outlook Application
description: Launches an Outlook application instance. Optionally connects to a specific profile.

fields.name: ProfileName
fields.label: Profile Name
fields.description: Optional: The Outlook profile name to use when launching Outlook.

fields.name: CreateNewInstance
fields.label: Create New Instance

fields.name: OutlookApplication
fields.label: Outlook Application
fields.description: The Outlook Application object created or reused by this activity.
